Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production FRAME-BY-FRAME 2D RPG boss sprite sheet for Jade Ascendant. Input image is only the approved rendering/style/proportion reference; do NOT copy its character identity. Character: Eclipse Ritual Hierophant: maroon gold ritual mage with eclipse crescent crown and staff. One consistent character in EVERY cell, same face, clothes, weapon, proportions, colors and pivot. Compact heroic proportions about3.5 heads tall. True flat hand-drawn 2D sprite art with crisp colored outlines, deliberate pixel clusters, three-tone cel shading, simple clean shapes readable at128px. Not a 3D render or realistic illustration. IMPORTANT precise regular SIX COLUMNS × SIX ROWS =36 isolated full-body cels on a square canvas, ideally1536x1536. Equal cells, generous transparent gaps; the entire body/weapon remains inside its own cell, no overlaps between cells, no decorative background, no text, no grids. Every frame faces3/4 right/front and has matching scale and feet baseline.
Row1 WALK: six distinct chronological walking drawings: left foot contact, weight down, passing right knee raised, right foot contact, weight down, passing left knee raised. Strong clear leg alternation, shoulders/hips counter-motion, modest robe follow-through. Not repeated standing pictures.
Row2 MELEE:6cels guarded ready → grounded crouch/weapon draw-back → wound-up torso → actual horizontal weapon strike → follow-through → recovery. Feet planted/braced during attacks. For ritual staff/fan characters use a short close-range staff/fan strike; empty hand can palm strike. No giant slash painted outside the cell.
Row3 AIMED PROJECTILE:6cels ready → gather at hand/weapon → compressed aim → thrust/release forward from hand/weapon tip → recoil → recover. Small controlled spark only, projectile itself rendered by game.
Row4 RADIAL RELEASE:6cels ready → inward gather → coiled charge → open arms/weapon outward → follow-through → recover. Feet braced, small body-tight energy only. The game owns the actual full radial volley.
Row5 SKY/SIGNATURE CAST:6cels ready → lift staff/sword/hand → overhead charge → strong upward spell gesture → follow-through → recover. This calls lightning/pillars/mirror/phoenix/crown magic according to identity; no falling lightning drawn across cells.
Row6 GROUND SHOCKWAVE:6cels ready → low weight anticipation → brace polearm/staff/fan or palms → ground-directed slam/press → follow-through → recover. The actual danger circle is rendered by game, don't paint an enormous floor ring.
All six cels in each action are intentionally different animation key drawings; consistent hands and weapon anatomy, natural weight, restrained follow-through. Keep costumes and anatomy identical across rows. No photoreal detail, airbrushed shine, filigree noise, floating sparks outside bodies, smoky halos, perspective changes, disembodied parts, giant spell rings or stretching one image. Truly transparent alpha around each figure. Draw animation poses, not concept-art variants.
